approved_scope: Complete active s32 numerical lifecycle, expressed as a separately versioned Community implementation with declared stochastic/scheduling semantics.

decisions.finding: Pinned source uses one-layer cuDNN-compatible GRU encoder and GRUBlockCell decoder, depth267, train_window283, final horizon63; intake LSTM/window60 claims superseded only in derived graph.

Source initialization distributions/dropout probabilities preserved; CPU per-model NumPy/torch streams are a declared implementation change. No identical-seed TensorFlow replay or checkpoint-trained-value claim.

Source has no explicit order between EMA reads, Adam and shared-step increment. Derived config explicitly specifies observation phases, default after/after. Review approves that deterministic contract, not a claim that it reproduces the source race.

Source constructs fingerprint/attention but use_attn=False prevents consumption by decoder; no attention term enters active loss. Excluding this disconnected branch preserves active computation while precluding full original checkpoint representation and seeded graph-equivalence claims.

Preparation, batching, full-width gradient updates, Adam/EMA state, source stop/checkpoint cadence, three-model count-space averaging and dated integer output are executable and tested. Synthetic short/full-batch cases support computational validity; no benchmark-accuracy claim.
Runtime-only versioned payload, explicit config, strict data validation; no bundled records, weights, original file export or competition-specific date slice.

tier_qualification: Community Tier3 only; no human certification or Tier2 usage/adversarial qualification.
remaining_publication_actions: Served catalog materialization and execution verification
